data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.8m (2016: run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.event_name: Whole Account Quota Share reserve movements with Syndicate 2003
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) related to reserve movements on the 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account under Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small favourable prior year run-off of GBP 0.8m in 2017, attributable wholly to reserve movements on the 2012-2014 years of account under Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003. This represents a modest release against opening gross claims reserves of GBP 116.631m and is classified as favourable claims development on reinsured treaty business.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) as at 31 Dec 2016 (prior year comparative). Prior year development taken from Note 'MOVEMENT IN PRIOR YEAR'S PROVISION FOR CLAIMS OUTSTANDING' which states a favourable run-off deviation of GBP 0.8m; the note does not explicitly label the figure 'gross' or 'net', but is treated here as a gross prior-year release per the note heading and wording. A gross claims development triangle is available (used for cross-checks).
